research_topic: Why does time seem to flow in only one direction?
reframed_question: Can a resolution-aware cross-scale inference program distinguish physical entropy production from preparation, hidden-variable, coarse-graining, and record-formation asymmetries while treating the cosmological low-gravitational-entropy problem as an explicit boundary condition?

subhypotheses.claim: Trajectory-level entropy production is operational only under declared dynamical, bath, protocol, and observation assumptions.
subhypotheses.writing_boundary: Do not generalize a model-specific estimator into a universal cause of time.

subhypotheses.claim: Coarse graining and decoherence affect accessible records and inference without alone fixing a universal boundary condition.
subhypotheses.writing_boundary: Keep system-environment and record statements separate from net dissipation.

subhypotheses.claim: Cosmological temporal asymmetry requires an account of low gravitational entropy rather than the simple assertion that the early universe was already maximally disordered.
subhypotheses.writing_boundary: Do not claim a settled gravitational-entropy definition or an experimentally measured early-universe entropy.

prohibited_claims: Entropy literally causes time to flow as a dynamical substance.
A state of thermodynamic equilibrium erases all microscopic temporal structure.
The proposed work measures the entropy of the early universe.
Synthetic trajectories are observed physical data.
